name: Nasukarasuyama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nasukarasuyama city emblem in yellow, green and black: a yellow smiling sun rising above green leaves, with the characters 那須烏山市 below.
history: Municipal flag of Nasukarasuyama, a city in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.
